input_vague: escríbeme un blog post sobre por qué nuestra startup adoptó rust
output_optimal:
<role>Technical writer for HN front page audiences. Knows what reads as authentic vs marketing.</role>

<context>
Migration: Go → Rust on settlement service, completed Q1 2026, 6-month project.
Metrics: p99 340ms → 22ms; memory 4.2GB → 280MB; panics 14/year → 1/year.
What went wrong: 3 weeks lost to lifetime-fighting; one senior engineer left over the curve.
</context>

<audience>
Senior engineers/tech leads at 20-200 person companies, evaluating Rust skeptically. They've read "Rust at $BIG_CO" posts and want the unglamorous truth.
</audience>

<voice>
First person plural. Technical, no hype. Vary sentences 8-25 words. Concrete situations not abstractions.
</voice>

<structure>
1. Moment we knew Go wasn't going to work.
2. What we tried first.
3. Rust decision: who pushed, who resisted.
4. Migration: 3 things better than expected, 2 worse.
5. The numbers.
6. What we'd do differently.
7. Position, not summary.
</structure>

<length>1400-1700 words.</length>

<forbidden_vocabulary>
delve, embark, journey, tapestry, vibrant, holistic, leverage, navigate, unlock, revolutionize.
</forbidden_vocabulary>

<self_check>
Read first paragraph aloud. Find sentences with two abstract nouns side by side. Verify every metric is in context.
</self_check>
why_excellent: Pasa el rational stranger test. Tech context con números verificables. Voice anchor concreto. Estructura arco-emocional. Forbidden list completa. Self-check falsificable.
